## Step 1: Use the property of inscribed angles
In a circle, the measure of an inscribed angle is half the measure of the central angle that subtends the same arc. Since the sum of all central angles in a circle is $360^\circ$, the sum of all inscribed angles that subtend the same arc is half of that, or $180^\circ$.
